title: Extract SessionGraph and retire Gateway Work Summary

capability.trigger: Open SessionGraph independently or call its existing MCP launcher
capability.outcome: Independent graph app; no summary module in Gateway

runtime: Owns graph browsing, settings, event-driven extraction and MCP

invariants: Project databases and evidence remain in place
No models during migration or retrieval
Shared queues and locks remain single-owner
non_goals: Change extraction algorithms or model selection
Delete existing generated reports or caches

acceptance_criteria.statement: Independent installed app reads fruit-fly graph and evidence
Gateway no longer mounts graph or summary, schedules summary generation, or registers retired IPC
Launcher and project identity survive runtime-owner switch without graph rebuild

git.base_revision: Gateway ab609506bd61f3d4c93e32d8d977de07d2b88b5a plus existing dirty SessionGraph changes
git.notes: Complete on-disk source extracted, including prior dirty changes. Standalone directory has no Git baseline; no commit requested. Unrelated Gateway changes preserved.

current_truth_evidence.source: Gateway frontend, native IPC, runtime and packaging inventory
current_truth_evidence.summary: Python runtime and graph UI can be isolated; Work Summary owns separate generation/cache logic.

architecture_decisions.statement: Retain existing shared state path and launcher; switch source to immutable app-owned runtime
architecture_decisions.rationale: No duplicate queue, lock or DB, and existing registrations remain valid

architecture_decisions.statement: Explicit exact Responses endpoint with private endpoint-scoped credential or environment variable; legacy reuse only on matching loopback
architecture_decisions.rationale: Independent runtime without forwarding unrelated Codex credentials to remote endpoints

slices.title: Independent desktop and Gateway retirement
slices.user_outcome: Graph app works independently; Codex composes summaries
slices.dominant_risk: Breaking existing runtime connections during app replacement

included: Runtime source ownership and provider configuration

decisions.idempotency_boundary: Existing install lock and atomic backed-up launcher/runtime writes
decisions.recovery_behavior: Restore matching launcher/runtime pair from backups
decisions.user_approval_point: User requested implementation; no real chats are deleted

evidence.source: Standalone runtime/tests, frontend and native tests
evidence.summary: Frontend 86 passed after reducing provider form to BASE URL, API KEY, MODEL NAME. Covers automatic Responses suffix, complete-endpoint compatibility, exact unchanged credential endpoint, blank-key preservation, hidden environment configuration and key clearing. Python 1256 passed and Rust 8 passed, 1 ignored in extraction verification; these layers unchanged by the form simplification. No models used.

evidence.source: Gateway frontend/native regression and installed bundle
evidence.summary: Frontend 418 passed; Rust 870 passed, 2 ignored. Signed 1.0.71 installed; installed binary owns loopback 4317. Retired native commands and active modules absent; only one-release import forwarders remain.

Final signed SessionGraph 0.1.0 installed. Shared launcher uses immutable standalone runtime 709151b7ac082ae19e16. Actual stdio MCP lists 7 tools, recalls and expands fruit-fly evidence. Native graph/status/settings reads succeed, MiniMax-M3 unchanged, 5 Hook events and MCP registration present. model_calls=0. Final reinstall is idempotent.

evidence.source: output/playwright/desktop.png and mobile.png; sg-extract browser session
evidence.summary: Real fruit-fly read-only UI displays nonblank SVG graph; node selection shows matching detail and quoted evidence. Desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 checked; mobile document width 390, 24 rendered nodes. Native app rendering/settings read checked separately; manual native fruit-fly selection was not verified.

traceability.user_promise: Standalone graph app with retained evidence
traceability.architecture_rule: One runtime owner and unchanged project databases
traceability.positive_test: Runtime fruit-fly graph and evidence smoke
traceability.regression_guard: Existing runtime/UI/Rust tests plus provider and removal tests

residual_items.description: One-release Gateway import forwarders support older live MCP processes; shared state retains its historical directory name.
residual_items.exit_condition: Reconnect old MCP processes before removing compatibility forwarders.

residual_items.description: Standalone source is on disk without a committed Git baseline; local signed bundles are not Apple-notarized.
residual_items.exit_condition: Create a reviewed source baseline and a separate notarized release when public distribution is requested.

completion.decision: Requested local extraction, removal, install and scoped verification complete. Not a public/reproducible release: standalone Git baseline and notarization remain separate release work. Existing provider configuration was preserved, not exercised with a paid model call.
